subject: a mist-blue hydrangea cluster
pose: cluster low, outer florets facing light
art_direction: 雾蓝绣球只有一簇在低处清楚，雨后的珍珠水滴轻轻点亮小花瓣。

composition: Native vertical 1024x1536 phone wallpaper. Design the full tall canvas with convincing depth, elegant leading lines and a strongly resolved focal scene in the middle and lower areas. Leave the upper roughly 20% naturally quiet for a lock-screen clock, using open sky, mist, water, a wall or a gentle color field; do not draw any clock or UI. Do not put essential faces or details at the extreme sides. Use a full-bleed rectangular composition, no border, no circular frame. Let scale, texture, atmosphere and beautiful lighting create the impact. Preserve clarity instead of filling every area with ornament.
creative_direction: Photograph a single mist-blue hydrangea cluster low in the frame, focusing on a few outer florets holding clear rain droplets. The small petals remain softly matte beneath the water, with pale green stems emerging below. Use overcast daylight and a shallow depth of field that turns the upper background into gentle gray-blue atmosphere rather than more flowers. Vertical 1024x1536. Reserve the upper twenty percent as naturally quiet negative space, keeping detail lower in the composition. Original peaceful image, no text, branding, or watermark.
